name: Bernard Fox
bio: Bernard Lawson (11 May 1927 – 14 December 2016), better known as Bernard Fox, was a Welsh actor. He is remembered for his roles as Dr. Bombay in the comedy fantasy series Bewitched (1964–1972) and Colonel Crittendon in the comedy series Hogan's Heroes (1965–1971).
place: Port Talbot, West Glamorgan, Wales, UK
